meta.home_title: YOGAMATY™ — the conscious layer between you and your yoga mat
meta.default_description: YOGAMATY™ is a premium hemp and reclaimed-sari yoga mat towel/cover, handwoven by independent women artisans in Nepal — the first pilot of TransparaTrade™, a transparent supply chain you can follow step by step.

footer.tagline: The conscious layer between you and your yoga mat
footer.fine: YOGAMATY™ and TransparaTrade™ are developed by Empowerment Collective, a 100% survivor-led nonprofit, with Global Women’s Handicrafts and the End Modern Slavery Now! movement. This site sets no cookies.
footer.test_build: Test build: the illustrations are placeholders; final artwork will be created with Nepali Mithila, embroidery and other artists.

passport.not_found: We couldn't find a record for batch
passport.load_error: We couldn't load the record. Please try again in a moment.
passport.template_body: No real batch data has been entered yet; the values below are placeholders. They are replaced when the batch record is published.
passport.how_collected_1: Every record on this page was entered by hand by a named person at Empowerment Collective, and each change leaves a dated entry in the website's change history. This is a deliberately rudimentary prototype.
passport.how_collected_2: That is exactly the weakness TransparaTrade exists to fix: when companies enter their own data by hand, those not committed to ethics can enter false data. The automated version would record each stage's data at the source, with proof of where, when and how it was entered. YOGAMATY is never shown with a verified Green label until the criteria and verification processes exist.
passport.elec_title: What uses power, and what doesn't.
passport.elec_1: Weaving stages use no electricity. Some other stages — sewing during finishing, and possibly some bobbin winding — may. Publishing both facts side by side is more credible than either one alone.
passport.elec_2: We do not describe the complete production process as electricity-free. Electricity is measured per production batch where feasible; weaving stages are genuine zeroes.
passport.elec_how: Total kWh metered for the batch, divided by the number of pieces. This is an average, not a per-piece measurement.
passport.of_benchmark: of the Seven Keys local benchmark
passport.wage_note: Living income is the objective being measured, not an outcome already achieved. If a figure cannot be published, we publish who verified it and how.
passport.env_rule: We publish only what was measured, label estimates as estimates, and name the method. Per-piece averages are labeled as averages.
passport.recycled_content: Reclaimed sari, share of the primary textile input by weight
passport.recycled_how: About 38.5% of the primary textile input by weight is reclaimed sari fabric. The finished-product percentage is published once the piece is weighed.
passport.water_per_mat: Water used in processing, per piece (average)
passport.water_how: Measured once for a batch, then divided by the number of mats.
passport.dye_claim: No dyes or chemicals are added in making YOGAMATY. The reclaimed saris carry their original dyes, so we do not call it “dye-free,” and we make no “fully biodegradable” claim because reclaimed saris may contain mixed fibers.
passport.standard_lead: These are measured or documented once and reused until something changes.
passport.withheld: Some details are withheld to protect the women who work on the product.
passport.bridge: This record is hand-entered. TransparaTrade would make it automatic, and make it the law.
